question: I moved here with a car. Who do I tell, and what do I have to pay?

nuggets.text: A motor vehicle operated in the District must be registered with the Department of Motor Vehicles.
nuggets.quote: (a) Except as provided by § 50-1401.02 , any motor vehicle or trailer operated in the District of Columbia shall be registered with the Department of Transportation by the owner of that motor vehicle or trailer.

nuggets.text: Registration fees are set by vehicle weight.

nuggets.text: The DMV mails a renewal notice at least 30 days before registration expires.
nuggets.quote: The required notice shall be mailed to the named owner at the address of record at least 30 days prior to the date of expiration.

nuggets.text: The Mayor (DMV) issues certificates and tags.
nuggets.quote: (b) (1) Except as provided in subsections (d) and (e) of this section, a registration shall be valid for a period determined by the Mayor and shall expire at midnight of the last day of the designated period.
